verdict.rationale: Neon's core product feature is instant copy-on-write branching of Postgres databases including schema and data, documented explicitly in the branching docs, and corroborated by independent community usage describing branching off main to test and reset ('We can branch off the main database to test things out, and periodically reset the branch to its parent'). Instant restore and branch-based workflows are further documented, reinforcing the copy-on-write branch model used for dev/test against production-shaped data. Missing for 10: deeper hands-on verification of 'production-shaped data' fidelity at scale beyond a single community quote.
